name: dsh-rightbar
description: Right bar: vncode' own right Sidebar for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI - the tab strip, the docking panel, the expand control, the tab-type registry (sidebarRightTabs/sidebarRight), the keyed tab seats and the Start/guide page. Vendored from the shipped @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right bundle so the pack owns the code, with the patch list in scripts/sync-vendored.ps1 applied on top (today: the dock's two-pane cap lifted to the kit's own four, all five drop zones offered, the dock RENDERED by the kit's recursive DockSurface - the flat DockLayout throws on anything but two panes side by side, so a stacked pane used to retire the bar until a reload - the wrapper that renderer leaves bare given the two things the flat renderer's tab host provided (the bar's own LEFT SEAM and an OPAQUE --dsw-alias-bg-base FILL, without which a FULLSCREEN bar is transparent and shows the conversation through every pixel the active tab does not paint itself), and the fullscreen panel put on the kit's own dock LAYER (z-index 40) so it paints above the app's persistent chrome - the composer seat (7/9), the frame's handles and seats (11/15/20), the pack's command dock (21) and the sidebar's fixed controls (30) - while every transient layer (the kit's tab menu 70, tooltips and menus 100/101, modals 1000, toasts 1100) still wins); the bundle layer disables the core row. Alpha.
